opening.argument: The material identifies itself as an advertorial rather than presenting itself as CryptoNews.com editorial content. It expressly states, “JUST OPINION! I AM NOT AN EXPERT! I DO NOT GUARANTEE A PARTICULAR OUTCOME,” while the investment discussion also advises viewers to maintain a balanced approach to mitigate potential losses. Although it reports that HUMP could potentially rise 20 to 50 times its current value and includes the instruction, “Click here to buy Hump Token,” those features alone do not establish deception. The available evidence shows conditional market commentary, disclosed limitations, and a purchase direction, but it does not establish that the projection was knowingly misleading or that any promised result was delivered.
